name: @free-compute/github-actions-public-compute-provider
description: A fail-closed dispatcher and public workflow for zero-cash standard GitHub-hosted test compute.

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: one immutable public source commit and optional bounded patch dispatched to one public repository workflow on a standard ubuntu-latest GitHub-hosted runner
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: private or unknown repository, mutable ref, larger or self-hosted runner, secret-bearing workflow, artifact, cache, caller shell command, oversized patch, absent Actions policy evidence, or more than fifteen execution minutes
